personality_one_liner: A tactical, high-contrast command center that feels like operating a piece of advanced hardware.

spacing.rule: Dense, tactical spacing for a command-center feel. Use padding to create clear hit targets without unnecessary empty space.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary and surfaceTertiary for elevation instead of glass, ensuring maximum contrast and legibility during live data tracking.
dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. This is a Dark-First Utility app.

screens.name: Device (Home)
screens.purpose: Configure BLE connection to the matrix and provision Wi-Fi credentials.

states.empty: No devices found. Ensure matrix is in pairing mode.
states.error: Failed to connect to Matrix. Retry pairing.

screens.layout: Header: 'Aura' wordmark. Hero Card: 'abstract glowing led matrix dark background' with gradient scrim and connection status (Disconnected/Connected). Section 1: Bluetooth pairing list/button. Section 2: Wi-Fi Setup form (SSID, Password) with 'Send to Matrix' button. FAB floating at bottom right for 'Sync All Settings'.

screens.name: Flights
screens.layout: Hero image: 'abstract flight radar aviation dark background' with gradient scrim and 'Flight Radar' title. Content: Master Enable Toggle. Input field for Location (ZIP or Lat/Lon). Thick slider for Search Radius (0-100 miles) with bright amber fill. FAB floating at bottom right.

screens.name: Sports
screens.purpose: Select favorite teams across 5 major leagues.
screens.layout: Hero image: 'dark empty sports stadium arena lights' with gradient scrim. Content: Master Enable Toggle. Horizontal Scroll / Segmented Control for Leagues (NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, UFC). Grid (2-col or 3-col) of team cards for the selected league. Selected teams get a 1.5pt borderStrong outline in brandPrimary (Amber) and a solid brandTertiary background. FAB floating at bottom right.

screens.name: Weather
screens.purpose: Enable local NWS weather alerts and set severity threshold.
screens.layout: Hero image: 'dark stormy weather radar abstract map' with gradient scrim. Content: Master Enable Toggle. Stacked radio cards for Severity Level (Minor, Moderate, Severe, Extreme) using surfaceSecondary for inactive, brandTertiary for active. FAB floating at bottom right.

hero_device.alt: Vibrant digital art showcasing an abstract matrix with red and black hues.

hero_flights.alt: Night view of illuminated airplane cockpit with runway visible

hero_sports.alt: Aerial view of an illuminated sports stadium at night

hero_weather.alt: dark stormy weather radar abstract map

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Dark-First Utility guidelines strictly. DO NOT use Glassmorphism. Use solid surfaceSecondary instead.
Implement a bottom tab bar with 4 tabs: Device, Flights, Sports, Weather.
Place a persistent floating action button (FAB) at the bottom right corner (above the tab bar) to trigger 'Sync All Settings' globally.

MANDATORY SCRIM: For all hero images at the top of each screen, implement a vertical LinearGradient scrim from transparent to >=75% surfaceInverse (black) at the bottom, so title text overlay is legible.

For the Sports screen team grid, use the provided fallback images since transparent logos weren't perfectly matched. Render them as cover images in the team cards with a gradient scrim at the bottom containing the team name.
Use Barlow Condensed for all section headings, numeric metrics, and titles. Use IBM Plex Sans for body, labels, and forms.
Forms on the Device screen (Wi-Fi Setup) should have labels above the input fields. Use surfaceTertiary for the input background.
Sliders must use a thick track (surfaceTertiary) with brandPrimary (Amber) for the filled track, and a large white thumb.
